text: The meeting identified usability challenges for an older user group, noting the need for larger buttons. (based on item 0)
Budget constraints were raised, questioning the feasibility of LCD hardware within 12.5 euros. (based on item 1)
The team questioned the viability of implementing speech recognition at around €25 price point. (based on item 2)
Decisions established that the remote control should be a TV remote and not a two-level remote. (based on items 3 and 4)
There are overall concerns about usability of proposed features. (based on item 5)
